p.title: v59.97 the AI action gate catches nominalised, sized, colloquial, two-sentence and emphasised trade instructions
p.symptom: Fifteen instruction spellings passed the AI action gate unchanged, among them 'NVDA를 매수하는 것을 추천합니다.', 'NVDA 비중을 30%로 늘리세요.', 'NVDA **매수**를 추천합니다.', '손절가는 1,050달러입니다. 그 가격에서 정리하세요.', 'NVDA를 매수\n하세요.', '손절은 천오십 달러에서 하세요.' and 'Consider buying NVDA now.'.
p.root_cause: The gate matched raw text sentence by sentence against verb-final patterns only: markdown emphasis and a soft line break split the action from its verb, noun-clause recommendations, sized weights, allocations, colloquial and position-object imperatives, Korean number words and English soft imperatives had no pattern, and a price sentence plus a referring imperative was never read as one instruction.
p.fix: _aioApplyAIActionGate matches a normalised copy of each sentence (NFKC, emphasis and backticks removed), reads a soft-line-break pair and a price-then-'그 가격에서 …하세요' pair together, and adds the named families nominalised, sizedWeight, allocation, colloquialHold, positionImperative (dispose verbs only with a position object), englishSoft and Korean number words in pricedImperative; the published text is untouched unless a sentence is replaced.
p.violated_rule: No trade instructions: the app never tells the reader to buy or sell, at what price or size (AGENTS product rule; P1539 action gate).
p.prevention: scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs v59.97 block: the fifteen spellings must be replaced with no ticker or price left, and the analysis sentences closest to each new family (attributed rule, negation, level fact, conditional, weight fact, allocation fact, '근거를 정리하세요', '질문을 던지세요', a non-trade imperative after a price sentence, a heading line break, third-person 'consider buying') must stay unchanged.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs (the 15 new replace assertions failed on the old source, pass now); ci-ai-chat-reliability-contract-check, ci-pipeline-semantics-check, regex-term and text-pin ratchets, boot bundle budget exit 0; a 3,000-character near-miss answer runs through the gate in about 2 ms.

changelog: **AI action gate reads normalised text and more instruction spellings ({P}):** noun-clause and sized recommendations, allocations, colloquial and position imperatives, a price sentence followed by '그 가격에서 정리하세요', emphasis, a soft line break, Korean number words and 'Consider buying' are now replaced with the no-instruction notice; analysis sentences close to each spelling stay.
note: v59.97: AI action gate normalises and widens instruction spellings
